- .claude/scripts/loaded_settings_check.py:83 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: When the recorded and on-disk settings hashes are both the literal string "absent", the check reports `current=True` even though there is no settings file to verify.
  WHY: This violates the documented fail-closed behavior for direct invocations; severity is highest because minimax_minimax-m3 rated it MAJOR while deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, and z-ai_glm-5_2 rated it NIT.
- .claude/commands/fix-claude-pr.md:46 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The sentence "The sync's merge commit rides this fix's push." does not distinguish the normal path from the settings-restart path, where the sync merge is dropped.
  WHY: The contradictory instructions can confuse an agent about whether to push the sync merge during a restart.
- .claude/hooks/settings_load_recorder.py:51-56; .claude/scripts/loaded_settings_check.py:41-52 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The recorder and checker independently duplicate contract constants, including the record directory, absent marker, and session-id sanitization regex.
  WHY: A one-sided change can make the checker look in a different location or interpret the record differently, resulting in missing records and unnecessary restart loops.
- .claude/hooks/settings_load_recorder.py:67-72 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `file_sha256()` returns `"absent"` on any `OSError`, and the recorder can persist that value when the settings file exists but encounters a transient read error.
  WHY: If no later `ConfigChange` replaces the record, subsequent checks can misrepresent whether the session loaded the settings file.
- .claude/hooks/settings_load_recorder.py:137-145 | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: `write_record()` re-raises `BaseException` variants, but `main()` catches only `Exception`.
  WHY: A propagated `KeyboardInterrupt` or `SystemExit` could terminate the hook with a non-zero exit code despite its contract to exit 0.
